title: Define source-backed CCP2 admission test inputs
description:
Scope: a separately versioned configured-constraint fixture supplement with strict schema/inventory under /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/, reusing validation patterns in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/python/tests/timing/test_duty_cycle_vectors.py where suitable. Define typed units, basis/profile/configuration identifiers, cited rule clauses, required evidence, and allowed/disallowed/unverified cases from authority.02, authority.05 and authority.06. Specify the expected case-consumption contract without adding production admission logic. Do not reinterpret operating authority, create a generic framework or overwrite the already frozen base corpus.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use the existing fixture tree and strict-schema registration; no new directory or helper is mandatory. Keep the source rule matrix and legal interpretation with the authority leaves, and freeze supplemental expected values independently of production results.
acceptance_criteria: The supplement has its own version/digest and references the immutable base-corpus release. Closed-schema tests reject missing basis, ambiguous units, unknown shapes, duplicate IDs, missing cases and empty inventories. Configured bandwidth/hopset and occupancy rules match the authority handoffs exactly; absent authorization/configuration evidence does not become permission. Independent source-backed inputs and expected rejection conditions are sufficient for later Python/Rust/C consumers. RF measurement and grant review are explicitly outside this software-input contract.
